label: ' of' standing free instead of completing the word before it: it opens its own set phrase after a comma, a verb or 'is/was' (', of course', ', of late', 'of necessity', 'of her own accord', 'came of age', 'are of no concern'), or starts a sentence or title ('Of all the...', 'Of Mice and Men'). Quiet when the word before asks for the 'of': noun of noun ('cup of coffee', 'a man of courage'), 'afraid of', 'think of', 'consists of', 'out of', 'kind of', 'because of'; partitive 'one of / all of the' stays weak.
